gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the cheapest under-$3,000 kit per Wh that ships now is the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W kit (3,168 Wh, 3,200 W) at $1,318.24 through our link, or about $0.42 per Wh. On the same date every BLUETTI kit of 2 kWh or more was a pre-order, and Jackery's kit panels were also on pre-order.
standout_why: I compared against StormWatts (cited in both chats), which lists 24 maker-store kits priced on 2026-11-08. Its lowest price per kWh is $578 (BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W), and its lowest for a 3 kWh kit is $683 (EcoFlow DELTA 3 Ultra + 2x220 W). It leaves out ALLPOWERS entirely, and its shipping states are 9 days old. For example, it lists BLUETTI Apex 300 + 2x200 W as 'Listed', but the BLUETTI store showed it today as a pre-order dispatching late January 2027. ChatGPT's own answers list the Elite 200 V2 + 2x200 W at $1,499 as 'best value' and never mention that it is a pre-order dispatching Nov 26. I could not open solargenadvisor, powersized, preparedstates, lightsonlabs or our own two cited pages (WebFetch SSL error on dealectric.com), so I have not checked whether they mention R3500 kits.
decides: Under the ship-now rule, the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 kit becomes the pick for a shopper who wants the most battery per dollar today: 3,168 Wh for $1,318.24 is about 44% less per Wh than the Anker F3000 + 400 W on Amazon ($0.749/Wh). The R3500 + SP039 600 W kit ($1,753.93, ships now, about 5.3 h of rated sun to refill) covers shoppers who want more panel. For anyone who can wait, the cheaper or larger options are BLUETTI Elite 400 + 2x200 W ($1,804.05, 3,840 Wh, $0.470/Wh, dispatching mid-December 2026, $398 less than the parts) and Elite 300 + 2x200 W ($1,614.05, $0.535/Wh, dispatching late November 2026). ChatGPT's 'best value' pick, the Elite 200 V2 + 2x200 W, costs $0.687/Wh and is also a pre-order.
